26532.d: Tarddiad (IPAc-en | t | ɑːr | ˈ | ð | iː | . | æ | d Respell-en | tar | THEE | add ) is the original homeworld of the Elves.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Sixth-Age circuit teleport to the World Gate
• The Book of Char teleport to Char's training cave, run south to the World Gate
• Eagles' Peak lodestone teleport, run south to the World Gate
• Quest Cape or master quest cape teleports
